A reminder that by products are not bad and we know what they are. They’re defined by AAFCO as what is leftover or not needed generally from animals used in the human meat supply chain, and that “this doesn’t mean byproducts are unsafe or lack nutrition—they just aren’t part of the original primary products.” By products include “non-rendered, clean parts, other than meat, derived from slaughtered mammals. It includes, but is not limited to, lungs, spleen, kidneys, brain, livers, blood, bone” and by products do not include “hair, horns, teeth and hoofs.” #cat #catfood #catnutrition #petsmart
